references.text: God tested Israel with manna to see if they would keep His law and walk in His ways
The Lord tested Israel in the wilderness to know their heart, to see if they would keep His commandments
God allows trials to test whether the people love the Lord and will follow His ways
Continuation of the same theme where nations were left to test Israel
The question of whether Israel will keep the Lord's laws and commandments
Command to walk in the way the Lord has commanded, as the fathers should do
Reminder to keep the Lord's commandments and walk in His ways as Moses commanded
Solomon's prayer that Israel may walk in the Lord's ways as their fathers did
